name: Acorn 6502 Tube Client
description: Tube Host client ROM for the 65C02 second processor used with the BBC Micro. The Tube Client serves as the operating system for the second processor, providing the standard BBC Micro MOS API by forwarding calls over the Tube interface to the host machine. The entire OS fits in just 2 kB, stored in the upper half of a 4 kB ROM device.
